SPIRITS_HIP_FLASK.title: Hip Flask
SPIRITS_HIP_FLASK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] for every [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Tipsy[/gold] you have.
SPIRITS_HIP_FLASK.flavor: Dutch courage, kept close to the heart.
SPIRITS_BEER_BELLY.title: Beer Belly
SPIRITS_BEER_BELLY.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]8[/blue]. At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to a quarter of your [gold]Tipsy[/gold] (max [blue]15[/blue]).
SPIRITS_TIP_JAR.title: Tip Jar
SPIRITS_TIP_JAR.description: Whenever you drink, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] for each [gold]Tipsy[/gold] it gives you.
SPIRITS_TIP_JAR.flavor: The house always pays the drinker. Eventually.
SPIRITS_DRINKING_BUDDY.title: Drinking Buddy
SPIRITS_DRINKING_BUDDY.description: Whenever a teammate drinks during combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIRITS_DRINKING_BUDDY.flavor: Never let a friend drink alone. Just watch their back.
SPIRITS_PINT_GLASS.title: Pint Glass
SPIRITS_PINT_GLASS.description: Whenever you [gold]Finish your drink[/gold], [gold]Chug[/gold] or take a [gold]Shot[/gold], heal [green]6[/green] HP.
SPIRITS_PINT_GLASS.flavor: Empty is just another word for ready.
SPIRITS_JUNGLE_JUICE.title: Jungle Juice
SPIRITS_JUNGLE_JUICE.description: At the start of each combat, gain a random buff, plus another for every [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Tipsy[/gold] you have (up to [blue]4[/blue]).
SPIRITS_JUNGLE_JUICE.flavor: Nobody knows what's in it. Nobody asks.
SPIRITS_CHASER.title: Chaser
SPIRITS_CHASER.description: Whenever you drink during combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIRITS_CHASER.flavor: One for the road. One for the ribs.
SPIRITS_CHEERS_TO_THAT.title: Cheers to That
SPIRITS_CHEERS_TO_THAT.description: Whenever a teammate drinks during combat, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
SPIRITS_SOCIAL_DRINKER.title: Social Drinker
SPIRITS_SOCIAL_DRINKER.description: The first time you drink each turn during combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
SPIRITS_SOCIAL_DRINKER.flavor: Only in company. There's always company.
SPIRITS_TOLERANCE.title: Tolerance
SPIRITS_TOLERANCE.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], plus [blue]1[/blue] more of each for every [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Tipsy[/gold] you have (up to [blue]4[/blue]).
SPIRITS_TOLERANCE.flavor: Years of practice, finally paying off.
SPIRITS_PARTY_ANIMAL.title: Party Animal
SPIRITS_PARTY_ANIMAL.description: At the start of your turn, if a teammate drank since your last turn began, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
SPIRITS_PARTY_ANIMAL.flavor: Feeds on other people's bad decisions.
SPIRITS_IRON_LIVER.title: Iron Liver
SPIRITS_IRON_LIVER.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]8[/blue]. Whenever you [gold]Finish your drink[/gold], [gold]Chug[/gold] or take a [gold]Shot[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]3[/blue].
SPIRITS_KINGS_CUP.title: King's Cup
SPIRITS_KINGS_CUP.description: At the start of each elite and boss combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Every other player takes a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_KINGS_CUP.flavor: Heavy is the head that pours the rules.
SPIRITS_WATERFALL.title: Waterfall
SPIRITS_WATERFALL.description: Whenever you drink during combat, ALL players gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and ALL enemies take [blue]5[/blue] damage.
SPIRITS_BAR_BRAWLER.title: Bar Brawler
SPIRITS_BAR_BRAWLER.description: Whenever you drink during combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
SPIRITS_BAR_BRAWLER.flavor: Throws the first punch, and the second, and the chair.
SPIRITS_KARAOKE_NIGHT.title: Karaoke Night
SPIRITS_KARAOKE_NIGHT.description: Whenever you drink during combat, ALL other players gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIRITS_KARAOKE_NIGHT.flavor: Nobody can hurt you while you're singing that badly.
SPIRITS_SPIKED_DRINK.title: Spiked Drink
SPIRITS_SPIKED_DRINK.description: Whenever any player drinks during combat, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SPIRITS_SPIKED_DRINK.flavor: Never leave your drink unattended. Especially near the Silent.
SPIRITS_ENERGY_DRINK.title: Energy Drink
SPIRITS_ENERGY_DRINK.flavor: Mixed with vodka, against medical advice.
SPIRITS_ROYAL_TOAST.title: Royal Toast
SPIRITS_ROYAL_TOAST.description: Whenever a teammate drinks during combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Star[/gold].
SPIRITS_ROYAL_TOAST.flavor: To the crown! The crown thanks you.
SPIRITS_BOTTLED_SPIRITS.title: Bottled Spirits
SPIRITS_BOTTLED_SPIRITS.flavor: Something in the bottle drinks back.
